## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Uragapetavatthu* ("The Snake", Pv 12) is a verse text in the *Petavatthu* collection of the Khuddaka Nikāya. Its theme concerns overcoming grief, addressing whether it is possible to remain free of sorrow when someone dies, an attainment ascribed to noble disciples of the Buddha. In studies on the chronology of the Pali Canon, the text is noted in the context of verse sharing and borrowing between the *Petavatthu* and the *Jātaka* collection [Kingsbury 2002].
